gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-tamil-: Noto Sans Tamil Supplement is stocky and tall in the middle, with round forms. Fuzzy Bubbles brings a loose handwritten looseness above it, and that mix of casual and crisp is the pair's best trick.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Fuzzy Bubbles looks marker-traced and friendly, rounded and unhurried with small letters nearly as tall as its capitals. Noto Sans Tangsa follows in a plain sans with wide openings and short ascender stems, so paragraphs move along smoothly without tiring the eye.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-tc: Relaxed and personal, Fuzzy Bubbles draws a monoline stroke from start to finish, with rounded letters that stay open. Noto Sans TC reads smoothly across many lines, its curves opening outward.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Noto Sans Telugu reads crisp and professional, its midline set high and its counters open to the outside. Fuzzy Bubbles, drawn like wire-cut strokes with a drafting-pen line, loosens the page while the sans-serif keeps it orderly.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana opens wide channels into each counter, giving big open lowercase forms with an approachable, professional feel. Fuzzy Bubbles' twine-like strokes add a hand-drawn warmth above.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-thai: Fuzzy Bubbles looks stencil-cut, one steady width, relaxed and rounded. Noto Sans Thai swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads, so give that plain sans a little extra size to let those open shapes breathe.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-thai-l: Fuzzy Bubbles draws every stroke without any thick-to-thin shading, so its rounded handwriting feels easygoing and personal. And Noto Sans Thai Looped, tall-bodied and bold-looking with spacious curve terminals, gives the page a firm, clean footing.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-tifina: Bent-tubing letters, soft and personal, lead the way, followed by rounded bowls that fill the line like inflated shapes. Fuzzy Bubbles handles the handwritten charm; Noto Sans Tifinagh handles the clean work.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-tirhut: Relaxed from the first glance, Fuzzy Bubbles has no hairlines to squint at, and its rounded letters stay open and inviting. Noto Sans Tirhuta, with its dominant x-height and cut-back terminals, reads cleanly.
gen-gf-fuzzy-bubbles-gf-noto-sans-ugarit: Noto Sans Ugaritic keeps x-height and cap height almost level, with open mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined. Against Fuzzy Bubbles' fixed nib width, the pair's strength is a friendly, hand-made feel.
